| Category = Egg recipes
| Servings = 8–10
| Difficulty = 2
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Omelet Recipes|Omelet Recipes]]

==Ingredients==
*½ loaf (1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]]) [[Cookbook:Bread|white bread]], cut into cubes
*680 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Cheddar Cheese|cheddar cheese]], shredded
*135 g cubed cooked [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]]
*8 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*475 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*1 g [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 dash [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot pepper sauce]], or to taste
*25 g [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:Green onion|green onion]]

==Procedure==
# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350 °F (175 °C). Lightly grease a 9x13-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (23 x 33 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) baking pan.
# Place half of the bread cubes on bottom of baking pan. Sprinkle with half of the ham and then half of the cheese; repeat.
# In a large bowl, beat together eggs, milk, salt, hot sauce and green onions. Pour egg mixture into pan.
# Place pan on top of a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] with a rim and place in oven. Pour water into baking sheet and bake for 60 minutes, or until eggs have set.
